title: Persona 佈建背景對帳在無待處理紀錄時略過資料庫租約寫入，消除每分鐘 32 次空轉負載

root_cause.summary: On hosted dev, bff.persona_provisioning (PostgresPersonaProvisioningStore) holds 4 succeeded rows and 165 retired rows (~9.7 MB table) and received ~32 row updates/min (~46,000/day) from the 5-second background reconciler (_reconcile_persona_provisioning_pass -> _reconcile_persona_provisioning_once / _reconcile_paper_enrollment_once). Each acquire() + release() cycle on PostgresPersonaProvisioningStore performs 3 SQL UPDATE statements (1 in acquire, 1 in release->checkpoint, 1 in release clearing lease_owner/lease_expires_at; ~10.67 passes/min * 3 UPDATEs = 32.0 row updates/min). Three defects in services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py caused steady-state ticks with only succeeded and retired rows to acquire and release leases on every pass: (1) _reconcile_persona_provisioning_once had no pre-lease bounded actionable-record check and projected any succeeded row lacking full post-readback fields as lifecycle_state='provisioning' while still attempting terminal ledger evaluation on every 5s tick; (2) _PERSONA_PROVISIONING_ORPHAN_SKIP was never ported to services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py when main.py was simplified (test_persona_provisioning_reconcile_orphan_skip.py had been testing a local stub function), so confirmed-orphan records raising PersonaReconciliationMutationError retried and churned leases every 5s forever; (3) _reconcile_paper_enrollment_once treated succeeded rows with permanent paper_enrollment.status='not_eligible' (e.g. the 4th live succeeded row outside the 3 enrolled trading personas) or exception outcomes missing attempted_at as immediately retry-due on every 5s pass.

changes.summary: Added _has_actionable_persona_provisioning_store_records (preferring store.list_non_terminal(limit=64) when exposed by the store port, with a bounded SELECT persona_id, state FROM <table> WHERE state NOT IN ('succeeded', 'retired') ORDER BY created_at ASC, persona_id ASC LIMIT 64 fallback on PostgresPersonaProvisioningStore and an in-memory terminal/orphan pre-check on MemoryPersonaProvisioningStore, and uniformly consulting the read surface active_store.list_personas() via _is_persona_provisioning_record_actionable across all three store paths before returning False, without any ReadSurfacePorts class-level list_personas early-return skip heuristic) and _is_persona_provisioning_record_actionable in _reconcile_persona_provisioning_once so idle ticks return 0 immediately before owner readback snapshots or lease writes while canonical-only read-surface provisioning and provisioning_failed personas still evaluate and clean up. Ported _PERSONA_PROVISIONING_ORPHAN_SKIP to services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py so confirmed orphans (PersonaReconciliationMutationError) are skipped after the first attempt. Added _is_paper_enrollment_record_actionable and _persona_owner_supports_paper_enrollment (using literal attribute checks to comply with BFF service architecture rules) in _reconcile_paper_enrollment_once so permanent not_eligible outcomes and backoff-throttled records do not acquire/release leases on idle ticks.

Bound existing orphan-skip tests to the real services.control_plane.bff.personas.service._reconcile_persona_provisioning_once and _PERSONA_PROVISIONING_ORPHAN_SKIP, and added regression tests proving steady-state ticks with only succeeded and retired rows (on both PostgresPersonaProvisioningStore and MemoryPersonaProvisioningStore, plus store.list_non_terminal(limit=64) delegation and ReadSurfacePorts class-level list_personas) perform 0 lease INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE writes while pending store rows and canonical-only provisioning/provisioning_failed read-surface personas reconcile normally.

Added regression tests for steady-state ticks with succeeded (complete, legacy, and not_eligible) and retired rows performing 0 lease writes across _reconcile_persona_provisioning_once and _reconcile_persona_provisioning_pass, pending row reconciliation alongside terminal rows, PostgresPersonaProvisioningStore reconciliation of canonical-only provisioning and provisioning_failed read-surface personas followed by 0-write steady-state idle ticks, and _PERSONA_CLEANUP_BACKOFF retry/settled skip semantics.

Updated the RC3 entry for services/control-plane/bff/persona_provisioning.py::{self.table} with the BFF-PERSONA-PROVISIONING-LEASE-LOAD-20261125 steady-state write cadence bound (0 lease row updates/min when idle, <=1 active leased row per reconciler lane when actionable work exists).

runtime_budget.cadence: 5 s background reconciler loop (PANTHEON_PERSONA_PROVISIONING_RECONCILE_SECONDS=5); 0 lease INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE writes/min when idle (down from ~32 row updates/min = ~46,000/day); active lease writes occur only when at least one provisioning record is non-terminal (reserved/provisioning), retry-due, or terminal-cleanup/compensation-due
runtime_budget.size_and_count_at_hosted_scale: 4 live succeeded rows and 165 retired rows on hosted dev (~9.7 MB table including historical JSONB owner receipts and prior HOT update bloat); bounded to <=1 leased row at a time per active reconciler pass
runtime_budget.growth_per_day: 0 rows/day and 0 B/day steady-state from the background reconciler; 0 lease row updates/day when idle
runtime_budget.cap: 1 row per (tenant_id, idempotency_key) in bff.persona_provisioning; bounded pre-check query reads at most 64 non-terminal rows (SELECT persona_id, state ... WHERE state NOT IN ('succeeded', 'retired') LIMIT 64) without detoasting JSONB payload columns
runtime_budget.cleanup: in-place lease release sets lease_owner=NULL and lease_expires_at=NULL on store.release(record); lease_expires_at TTL expiry reclaim on acquire() unchanged

verification.results: 153 passed in batch 1 (architecture, read_surface_mutation, orphan_skip, reconcile, readback) and 215 passed, 1 skipped in batch 2 (orphan_skip, store, paper_enrollment, tenant_fallback_audit, check_storage_manifest); scripts/check_storage_manifest.py passed=true with 0 failures; diff_budget exit 0.

residual_findings: services/control-plane/bff/persona_provisioning.py is outside BFF-PERSONA-PROVISIONING-LEASE-LOAD-20261125's declared artifacts contract (enforced at handoff by validate_task_artifact_diff_scope in .orchestrator/rewrite/task_contract.py), so PostgresPersonaProvisioningStore does not yet expose a first-class list_non_terminal(limit=64) method directly on the store class. _has_actionable_persona_provisioning_store_records in services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py already delegates to store.list_non_terminal(limit=64) whenever exposed and retains the bounded 64-row SQL fallback until persona_provisioning.py is updated in a follow-up RC3 slice.

PostgresPersonaProvisioningStore.release() in services/control-plane/bff/persona_provisioning.py (outside this task's artifact scope) executes self.checkpoint() (1 SQL UPDATE) followed by a second SQL UPDATE clearing lease_owner and lease_expires_at (2 UPDATEs on release, 3 UPDATEs per acquire+release cycle). Steady-state idle load is now 0 writes/min; combining checkpoint and lease clearing into a single atomic UPDATE in persona_provisioning.py during active transitions is an optional out-of-scope improvement under RC3.

PersonaProvisioningCoordinator._enroll_in_place in services/control-plane/bff/persona_provisioning_coordinator.py (outside this task's artifact scope) omits attempted_at in its fallback exception dict when _paper_enrollment() raises before enroll(). _is_paper_enrollment_record_actionable in services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py mitigates this by falling back to record.updated_at for retry_due throttling.
